title.zh: 保持无需麦克风的对话提交操作可见

purpose.en: Close the follow-up production layout defect where the newly enabled typed dialogue submit action inherited the site's intentional hidden-Check rule and therefore remained invisible.
purpose.zh: 修复后续生产布局缺陷：新启用的文本对话提交操作继承了全站有意隐藏 Check 的规则，因而仍不可见。

en: Give the typed dialogue submit action a dedicated visible class that does not inherit the hidden-Check rule.
Keep typed dialogue as the no-microphone default path and three-attempt voice scoring as an optional enhancement.
Preserve database-authoritative grading, feedback, and Continue behavior.
zh: 为文本对话提交设置专用可见样式，不再继承隐藏 Check 的全站规则。
保持文本对话为默认无需麦克风路径，三次语音评分为可选增强。
保持数据库权威判分、反馈及继续操作。

en: Signed-in subscribed-course dialogue training for all course languages; no Clerk, payment, administrator, sibling-site, or anonymous learning behavior.
zh: 所有课程语言的登录订阅课程对话训练；不影响 Clerk、支付、管理员、兄弟站点或匿名学习行为。

en: Render the dialogue submit button with a dedicated class and explicit visible primary-action styling.
Retain the optional microphone label and explicit no-microphone guidance from v32.
Extend regression coverage to prevent both logical gating and CSS hiding.
zh: 使用专用 class 渲染对话提交按钮，并明确设置可见的主操作样式。
保留 v32 的可选麦克风标签及无需麦克风说明。
扩展回归覆盖，同时防止逻辑门槛和 CSS 隐藏。

en: Run the dialogue visibility regression contract, TypeScript, the complete automated suite, D1 migration validation, sensitive-data scan, production-equivalent build, changed-file lint, and shared portfolio gates.
Deploy only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, then use the ordinary test learner with Repeat After Me off to submit real Spanish and Italian typed dialogue responses without microphone access.
zh: 执行对话可见性回归合同、TypeScript、全量自动化、D1 迁移、敏感数据扫描、生产等价构建、修改文件 lint 与共享组合门禁。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 发布到 Cloudflare，再由普通测试学员在跟读关闭且不访问麦克风的条件下提交真实西语、意语文本对话回答。

en: The remaining en/ja/es/it course matrix and observable normal-versus-slow audio timing require the fresh Terra production retest after this deployment.
zh: 剩余英/日/西/意真实学习矩阵及可观察的正常/慢速音频时长，需要在本次发布后由 Terra 重新执行生产验收。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's existing database authority, Repeat After Me default-off behavior, GitHub-to-Cloudflare delivery, and SmartLingo-only data boundaries.
Do not modify any other site, account, credential, payment rail, database binding, or cloud resource.
zh: 保持 SmartLingo 既有数据库权威、跟读默认关闭、GitHub 至 Cloudflare 发布及仅限 SmartLingo 的数据边界。
不修改其他站点、账户、凭据、支付通道、数据库绑定或云资源。
